info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Image API
Factset Get chart image back in PNG or JPEG formats

params.name: chart
params.description: Path to the saved chart. For any of the default charts, the option should be `categoryName + '/' + chartName`. For charts under the Client or Personal directories, the option should be `directoryName + ':/' + pathTotheChart`.

params.name: ids
params.description: List of identifiers to be charted in a comma(,) separated string. Only the first one would be considered as primary and rest would be added as comps. Check the catalog for more information on which charts require a ticker.

params.name: sd
params.description: Option for overriding the startDate of the chart. For absolute dates provide a string in `YYYYMMDD` format. We can also specify relative date options

params.name: ed
params.description: Option for overriding the endDate of the chart. For absolute dates provide a string in `YYYYMMDD` format. We can also specify relative date options

params.name: width
params.description: Option for setting the width of the image

params.name: height
params.description: Option for setting the height of the image

params.name: freq
params.description: A shorthand string for the overall frequency of the chart like `D` (daily), `W` (weekly), `Y` (yearly) and `Q` (Quarterly). This will default to frequency stored in the document.

params.name: ccy
params.description: Currency ISO code for the overall currency of the chart. The API doesn't allow per series currency at this point in time.

params.name: split
params.description: Option to specify the splits adjustment

params.name: spin
params.description: Numeric option to specify the spinOffs adjustment. Possible options include `0` (When we only want spits adjustment), `1` (spinOffs), `4` (spinOffs and cash dividends) and `9` (No adjustments)

params.name: cal
params.description: Option for the calendarType of the chart

params.name: title
params.description: Option to customize the title. If you don't customize the title, then it displays by default the security name.

params.name: type
params.description: The type of image to be generated by the service

params.name: gridLines
params.description: Option to toggle gridLines on/off on the chart
